name: matched-ks3-all-routed-direct-bf16
hypothesis: Remove GS32 rounding only from routed KS3 BF16 training inputs, weights and nonlinear outputs. Preserve dense KS3 GS32 encoding, geometry coefficient GS32, FP16 nonlinearities, original router/top1 and optimizer semantics, and fixed GS32 BF16 validation. Require direct/default numerical and cache checks plus a faster paired whole-model timing gate before discovery.
